facts.fact: The Finance Ministry says the new NIU, a mandatory taxpayer registration number issued by the tax directorate, was put into production on 10 August 2020 with fingerprints, iris and QR code.
The Finance Minister handed the Minister for small businesses enrolment equipment so entrepreneurs can obtain the NIU at the counter of the business-creation agency ACPCE.

systems.owner: Direction générale des impôts et des domaines

facts.fact: The NIU project coordinator says the NIU file is the taxpayer file of the tax directorate (DGID), and the NIU database holds over 28,000 legal persons beside natural persons.
The ministry says the NIU is compulsory for customs duty declarations and payments, and commercial firms request it through the business creation agency ACPCE.
